articles.title: OG.com cleared by SEC to offer single-stock futures, says Crypto.com CEO

articles.title: Zcash targets November for NU7 mainnet upgrade with 25-second blocks

articles.summary: Bitcoin made modest daily gains as US stocks saw upside in the aftermath of the US Federal Reserve’s first interest-rate hike since July 2023.

articles.title: Crypto tech provider Haruko hit by cyberattack affecting 15 clients, some funds lost

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin climbs over $80,000 as rally accelerates at U.S. market open
articles.summary: Another central bank hiked rates overnight, this time the Bank of Japan. The move failed to halt the slide in the yen.

articles.title: Bank of Japan raises interest rates by 25 basis points. Bitcoin tops $77,000

articles.title: Iran’s Strait of Hormuz toll booth ran through a bitcoin exchange, U.S. says
articles.summary: The U.S. Treasury sanctioned BitBank, a Tehran exchange it says moved hundreds of millions of dollars in bitcoin to the Revolutionary Guards and handled payments collected from ships buying passage through the world’s most important oil chokepoint.

articles.title: US sanctions Iran’s BitBank, saying it processes ‘Hormuz Safe’ Bitcoin payments
articles.summary: US Treasury says the Iranian exchange processed payments received through Iran’s Strait of Hormuz maritime scheme and helped move hundreds of millions of dollars in Bitcoin to the IRGC.

articles.title: Banks double on EU MiCA crypto provider list as share hits 23%
articles.summary: Banks now represent nearly one in four providers on ESMA’s MiCA register after roughly doubling their presence since late June.

articles.title: Layer-2 and DeFi tokens lead broad crypto advance as post-Fed hike nerves fade
articles.summary: Starknet and arbitrum gained more than 17% while the 10-year Treasury yield slipped back below 5%, with 98 of CoinDesk 100 constituents advancing.

articles.summary: The Securities and Exchange Commission today issued an order granting temporary, conditional exemptive relief to Tokenized Securities Venues each a “TSV” from the definition of “exchange” in the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 (Exchange Act) to trade…

articles.title: HYPE hits record above $90 as Hyperliquid launches manual borrowing
articles.summary: HYPE hit a record $90.92 after Hyperliquid opened manual borrowing, letting users borrow stablecoins against HYPE and Bitcoin collateral.

articles.title: World launches self-custodial ‘super app’ World Money
articles.summary: World Money is rolling out across more than 150 countries, combining stablecoin payments, digital asset rewards and trading in a self-custodial app.

articles.title: WisdomTree, MoonPay team up to expand US access to tokenized money market fund
articles.summary: MoonPay plans to use WisdomTree’s $1.2 billion WTGXX tokenized fund as part of its stablecoin reserves while helping expand access to US investors.

articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: Ether and XRP ETFs post outflows as crypto majors move higher
articles.summary: Ether funds shed money for a third straight session even as the token rose, while every major gained and zcash extended its run.

articles.title: Binance brushes off Lagarde MiCA speculation, reaffirms Europe commitment
articles.summary: Binance declined to address reports of ECB intervention in its Greek MiCA bid, saying it remains committed to securing authorization in Europe.

articles.title: Solana speeds up blocks by 17%, but transaction capacity stays the same
articles.summary: The network is cutting its target slot time to 250 milliseconds, giving apps fresher blockchain data and validators shorter control windows while reducing the amount of work allowed in each slot.

articles.title: Real stocks are finally coming on blockchain. Here’s how the SEC wants it to work
articles.summary: The SEC is giving tokenized stocks a regulated U.S. pathway, while keeping trading volumes, access and issuer rights tightly controlled.

articles.title: SEC opens door to tokenized U.S. stock trading. Here’s who could benefit
articles.summary: The five-year experiment gives DeFi-style trading venues, tokenization firms and liquidity providers a new U.S. pathway while leaving synthetic stock tokens outside the framework.

articles.title: Zcash miner Fortitude taps former Hut 8 CEO to lead ahead of public listing
articles.summary: Former Hut 8 CEO Jaime Leverton will take the helm at Fortitude as the Zcash-focused miner expands its operations and moves toward a planned public listing.

articles.title: Bitcoin weathers September storm as rate hikes and Clarity act setback test bulls
articles.summary: Bitcoin is down just 1.5% in its historically weakest month and remains on track for its first quarterly gain in a year, despite rising rates, surging oil and a stronger dollar.

articles.title: Corporate treasuries bought just 5,900 bitcoin in 3 months. Other demand signals look weak, too.
articles.summary: Corporate treasuries bought just 5,900 bitcoin in three months, while broader demand signals remain weak.

articles.title: Stablecoin payments firm dtcpay closes $25M round with SBI backing
articles.summary: Dtcpay plans to expand its merchant network and payment products after completing a $25 million Series A backed by Japan’s SBI Group.

articles.title: Ethereum Institutional signals support for Ethlabs’ motion to reduce Ethereum block times
articles.summary: The non-profit signaled support for reducing Ethereum block times, citing increasing institutional activity moving onto the smart-contract network.

articles.title: DHS’s predictive policing is unconstitutional, un-American and should be stopped
articles.summary: Targeting Americans based on what their spending habits can tell us about their politics is an abuse of our financial system, writes Coin Center’s Laz Pieper.

articles.title: ECB President Christine Lagarde intervened to block Binance’s EU MiCA license: WSJ
articles.summary: Although the ECB holds no formal licensing authority under MiCA, high-level intervention led Greece to stall an application that regulators had previously deemed complete, the Journal said.

articles.title: Dragonfly’s Qureshi calls for end to Zcash dev fund after 2028

articles.summary: The Fisher Transform indicator produced a rare crossover for only the fourth time in Bitcoin’s history.

articles.title: Bitcoin cycle bottom may already be in at $58K, says analyst James Check
articles.summary: Onchain analyst James Check says Bitcoin may have bottomed near $58,000 after two capitulations and warns against anchoring to an October low.

articles.title: Ethereum confirms Glamsterdam dates, but warns 'fake' builders could stall the chain
articles.summary: Free test ether lets fake builders outbid rivals and withhold transaction payloads, while client teams get half the usual review time before Sepolia.

articles.title: Cardano’s IOG warns users to avoid YouTube channel amid apparent hijack
articles.summary: Input Output Group told users to avoid its YouTube channel after it began livestreaming a suspected AI-manipulated Charles Hoskinson video promising to “double your wealth.”

articles.summary: The estranged daughter of 77-year-old Kathleen Allman has petitioned a Hawaiian court to establish a limited conservatorship to protect her parents’ share of her brother’s stake in Ondo.

articles.title: CFTC expands regulatory relief for passive trading software providers
articles.summary: The US regulator’s move could make it easier for crypto wallets and other apps to offer access to regulated derivatives and prediction markets without registering as introducing brokers.

articles.title: Kevin O’Leary says Congress will revisit Clarity early next year as crypto tax bill advances
articles.summary: The Shark Tank investor says Congress will face pressure to revive crypto market structure legislation as it moves to establish tax rules for digital assets.

articles.title: Is there any chance left to save the CLARITY Act?
articles.summary: CLARITY isn’t dead after failing a key Senate vote, but with time running short and Democrats still demanding changes, its path forward is narrowing.

editorial_principles.audience_value: Prefer stories that teach something, explain why a move matters, reveal an unusual development or create a substantive debate.
editorial_principles.breaking_news_override: A genuinely major verified breaking event may override topic cooldowns, but ordinary price movement may not.

editorial_principles.evidence: Separate verified facts, observed market data, inference and unknowns. Never invent a causal explanation or statistic.
editorial_principles.human_editor_test: Before selecting a topic, ask whether an experienced crypto editor would spend one of the account's limited publishing opportunities on this story right now.
editorial_principles.learning: Treat individual post performance as noisy. Do not declare a winning topic from one post; use repeated observations before changing strategy.
editorial_principles.novelty: Do not repeat the same asset, event or angle merely because its raw market score remains high.
editorial_principles.publish_standard: Publish only when a story is genuinely useful, timely, evidence-backed and differentiated. Skipping is better than filler.
editorial_principles.visual_quality: Use a visual only when it adds truthful information. Market charts must use real supplied market data.
